name: OnPay
summary: OnPay charges $49 a month plus $6 per worker for one full-service payroll plan, with federal, state and local tax filings, W-2s and 1099s included. Contractors and employees are paid in the same pay run at no extra charge. Its page names QuickBooks and Xero integrations, and it holds a SOC 2 Type II report.

facts.text: OnPay says it files taxes automatically across all 50 US states and the District of Columbia.
Employees and 1099 contractors are paid in the same pay run at no extra charge.
OnPay requires multi-factor authentication for its internal systems and tools, but only recommends it for clients.
The pricing page also says "Pricing starts at $55 per month" without explaining the gap to the $49 base fee.

plans.name: Payroll Essentials
plans.notes: Federal, state and local tax filings, W-2s and 1099s are included, with no implementation or integration fees. The page offers "Get one month free" with no terms stated

hiddenCosts: The page lists no separate state filing fee, but it also shows "Pricing starts at $55 per month", which it does not explain.
Benefits plans carry their own premiums.

contract.cancellation: The product page says pay runs come with no cancellation fees. It does not say whether a contract is required.
